title: Practice language (from language.mmd)
description: JSON Schema derived from the Mermaid classDiagram in language.mmd. Identity is by name; most cross-links are string names (not embedded objects). Root validation discriminates Practice vs Method vs PracticeBaseline. Method can use embedded objects (baselinePractice + practices) or string references (baselinePracticeName + practiceNames) or a mix.

AssetReference.description: Reference to a visual asset with semantic type classification. Enables rich visual associations for practice elements.

assetName.description: Name of an Asset in the same aggregate (symbolic link; must match Asset.name in top-level assets array).

type.description: Semantic type of asset usage. icon: UI markers, visual identity (e.g., alpha icons, competency badges). illustrative: Documentation diagrams, architecture visualizations, workflow charts. template: Reusable documents, forms, decision records. diagram: Technical architecture, state progression, pattern orchestration.

PracticeElement.description: Common identity and prose fields for named practice artifacts. tags optional: omit, structured buckets, or legacy string[].

tags.description: Canonical shape: orthogonal tag buckets. Legacy interchange: flat string array (tooling treats it as lifecycleTags only).

oneOf.description: Deprecated interchange; prefer the structured object.

narratives.description: Optional narrative breakdown embedded on any practice element (language.mmd).

assetNames.description: Optional array of asset references with semantic type classification (0..*). Enables multiple visual associations per element (e.g., alpha with both icon and state diagram).

AlphaContribution.description: Symbolic slice to an alpha state: STRING keys only; resolve (alphaName, stateName) to a State under the named Alpha; do not embed Alpha or State.

alphaName.description: Name of an Alpha in the same baseline (symbolic link; must match Alpha.name).

stateName.description: Name of a State under that Alpha (symbolic link; must match State.name within the named Alpha).

AlphaRelationship.description: Named semantic relationship to another alpha. Provides rich relationship semantics beyond contribution/specialization (e.g., 'depends on', 'influences', 'constrains', 'validates').

relationship.description: The type of relationship (e.g., 'depends on', 'influences', 'constrains', 'validates', 'precedes', 'enables'). Use domain-appropriate relationship names.

alphaName.description: Name of the related Alpha in the same baseline (symbolic link; must match Alpha.name).

PracticeElementAlias.description: Local name alias: aliasName is treated as an alternate string for (practiceElementType, practiceElementName) within the same document (language.mmd). Not a PracticeElement subclass; embedded under Practice.practiceElementAliases or PracticeBaseline.practiceElementAliases.

practiceElementType.description: Kind of element being aliased (e.g. Alpha, Activity, ActivitySpace, Focus, WorkProduct, Pattern, PatternView, AlphaInstanceName, WorkProductInstanceName, Competency, Persona, PersonaGroup, Narrative); must match how the target is stored in JSON.

practiceElementName.description: Canonical PracticeElement.name of the target within this practice aggregate.

aliasName.description: Alternate string equivalent to practiceElementName for resolution within this practice.

WorkProductContribution.description: Symbolic slice to a level of detail: STRING keys only; resolve (workProductName, levelOfDetailName) under the named WorkProduct; do not embed.

workProductName.description: Name of a WorkProduct in the same aggregate (symbolic link; must match WorkProduct.name).

levelOfDetailName.description: Name of a LevelOfDetail under that work product (symbolic link; must match LevelOfDetail.name).

focusName.description: Name of a Focus in the same baseline (symbolic link; must match Focus.name; do not embed a Focus object).

contributesTo.description: Optional name of another Alpha in the same baseline (0..1 specialization relationship). Used to create specialized alphas that contribute to/refine baseline alphas (e.g., 'Platform Capability' contributesTo 'Platform'). Do not embed an Alpha object.

relatesTo.description: Optional array of named semantic relationships to other alphas (0..*). Use for dependencies, influences, constraints, or other domain-specific relationships beyond specialization.

alphaName.description: Name of the Alpha this instance tracks (symbolic link; must match Alpha.name).
Name of the Alpha this instance tracks (symbolic link; must match Alpha.name).

stateName.description: Name of a State under that Alpha (symbolic link; must match State.name within the named Alpha).

evidenceBy.description: Embedded work-product instance rows that evidence this AlphaInstance (same aggregate).

checklistStates.description: Optional checklist completion tracking for this alpha instance. Each entry records the state of a checklist item within the referenced Alpha State.

workProductName.description: Name of a WorkProduct this instance grouping refers to (symbolic link; must match WorkProduct.name).
Name of the WorkProduct (symbolic link; must match WorkProduct.name).

levelOfDetailName.description: Name of a LevelOfDetail under that work product (symbolic link; must match LevelOfDetail.name).

checklistStates.description: Optional checklist completion tracking for this work product instance. Each entry records the state of a checklist item within the referenced LevelOfDetail.

ActivitySpaceCore.description: Symbolic swimlane slice shared by ActivitySpace rows and nested/flat Activity rows (contributions, focus, competencies, persona groups).

focusName.description: Name of a Focus in the same baseline (symbolic link; must match Focus.name; do not embed a Focus object).

requiredCompetencies.description: Each item is a Competency.name in the same baseline (symbolic link; do not embed Competency objects).

involves.description: PersonaGroup.name entries (symbolic links on the same Practice document or merged method scope; must match PersonaGroup.name, not Persona.name).

Activity.description: Swimlane activity; extends ActivitySpaceCore with work linkage and competency levels. Canonical JSON nests instances under ActivitySpace.activities; Practice.activities (flat) remains valid for legacy interchange.

activitySpaceName.description: Parent ActivitySpace.name; required in Practice.activities; optional when nested under ActivitySpace.activities (implicit parent).

ActivitySpace.description: Coordinates work in a focus area; extends ActivitySpaceCore with nested Activity children.

activities.description: Activities owned by this activity space (canonical shape, 0..*).

competencyName.description: Name of the parent Competency this level belongs to (symbolic link; must match Competency.name in the same baseline).

CompetencyLevelReference.description: Symbolic reference to a competency level by two STRING keys; resolve under the named Competency; do not embed.

competencyName.description: Name of a Competency (symbolic link; must match Competency.name).

competencyLevelName.description: Name of a CompetencyLevel under that competency (symbolic link; must match CompetencyLevel.name).

narrativeTypeName.description: Symbolic link to NarrativeType.name in the baseline (or practice overlay); patterns may hang a narrative spine (language.mmd).

alphaInstanceNames.description: Optional list of alpha instance declarations tracked by this pattern. Used in project plans to declare which alpha instances the pattern's views reference.

workProductInstanceNames.description: Optional list of work product instance declarations tracked by this pattern. Used in project plans to declare which work product instances the pattern's views reference.

PatternViewReference.description: Symbolic reference to a pattern view by two STRING keys; resolve under the named Pattern; do not embed.

patternName.description: Name of a Pattern (symbolic link; must match Pattern.name).

patternViewName.description: Name of a PatternView under that pattern (symbolic link; must match PatternView.name).

NarrativeContext.description: One slice of authored narrative keyed to a narrative element (STRING ref; resolve to NarrativeElement.name on the parent NarrativeType).

narrativeElementName.description: Symbolic link to NarrativeElement.name inside the NarrativeType named by enclosing Narrative.narrativeTypeName.

howToUse.description: Guidance for applying this spine element.

narrativeElements.description: Embedded narrative spine elements owned by this type (composition; language.mmd).

narrativeTypeName.description: Symbolic link to NarrativeType.name in scope (baseline narrativeTypes or practice overlay).

citationNames.description: Optional array of Citation.name references (symbolic links to citations in the same practice/method scope).

competencies.description: Symbolic competency level refs (same baseline or merged practice scope).

items.description: Persona.name entries (symbolic links in the same practice).

authors.description: The person, group, or organization responsible for the work (e.g., ['Skelton, M.', 'Pais, M.']).

source.description: Publisher, journal, or URL where the work can be retrieved.

url.description: URL or DOI where the work can be retrieved.
Optional URL associated with the acknowledgement, for example contact email `mailto:xx` or hyperlink to a profile page

alphaStates.description: Alpha/state slices for this pattern view. Canonical: embedded AlphaContribution objects. Legacy interchange: STRING tokens (e.g. "AlphaName→StateName" or "AlphaName->StateName").

alphaInstances.description: AlphaInstances that are expected outcomes for this pattern view.

activitySpaces.description: ActivitySpace.name entries for pattern-matrix swimlanes (symbolic links in the same baseline or practice). Legacy interchange: Activity.name may appear here; prefer the `activities` array for activities.

activities.description: Activity.name entries for pattern-matrix swimlanes (symbolic links to nested Activity under ActivitySpace or to flat Practice.activities).

description.description: Human-readable description of what the asset depicts and its purpose

path.description: Relative path to the asset file (e.g., 'assets/diagrams/pattern-lifecycle.svg')

dataUri.description: Optional base64-encoded data URI for small assets (<10KB)

url.description: Optional external URL for remotely-hosted assets

fontFamily.description: Font family name for font-character assets (e.g., 'Font Awesome 6 Free', 'Material Icons')

fontUrl.description: Optional URL to load the font from (e.g., Google Fonts, Font Awesome CDN, custom font file). If not provided, assumes font is already available.

PackageDependency.description: A dependency on another .keleo package. Declared when this package contains documents that reference names (baselinePracticeName, practiceNames, practiceDependencyNames) provided by an external package.

packageName.description: Name of the required package (must match PackageIdentity.name of the dependency).

versionRange.description: Semantic version range constraint (e.g., '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0', '^1.2.0', '1.x'). Consumers use this to select a compatible version from available packages.

documentNames.description: Optional explicit list of document names required from the dependency. When omitted, all documents from the dependency are available for resolution.

PackageDocument.description: An entry in the package document inventory. Maps a file path within the ZIP archive to its Practice Language document type and name.

path.description: Relative path to the JSON file within the ZIP archive (e.g., 'documents/my-practice.json'). Must begin with 'documents/'.

documentType.description: The root type of the JSON document, matching the schema's root discrimination result.

documentName.description: The 'name' property of the root document. This is the identity key used for symbolic resolution (e.g., the name that appears in practiceNames, baselinePracticeName).

entryPoint.description: True if this document is a primary entry point of the package. Entry points are the documents a consumer should resolve first.

PackageIdentity.description: Package identity and provenance metadata for a .keleo package.

name.description: Unique package name using kebab-case convention (e.g., 'platform-engineering-method', 'devsecops-practice').

description.description: Human-readable summary of the package contents and purpose.

authors.description: Package authors (may differ from individual document authors).

url.description: Optional URL for the package homepage, repository, or registry listing.

PackageManifest.description: Root object of manifest.json within a .keleo package. Declares the package identity, document inventory, entry points, and external dependencies. Validated via language.schema.json#/$defs/PackageManifest.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the Practice Language schema this package targets. Consumers use this to determine compatibility before parsing documents.

package.description: Identity and metadata for this package.

documents.description: Ordered inventory of all Practice Language JSON documents in this package.

dependencies.description: Optional array of external package dependencies. Declared when documents in this package reference names provided by other packages.

PracticeBaselineShape.description: PracticeElement + baseline arrays and metadata (no document-level unevaluatedProperties; compose into PracticeBaseline or Practice).

alphaInstances.description: Optional list of AlphaInstance names used to allow baselines to identify instances of concepts or areas of concern within the baseline.

narrativeTypes.description: Narrative spine types defined in this baseline aggregate (language.mmd).

citations.description: Bibliographic references defined in this baseline.

acknowledgements.description: Acknowledgements of people or institutions that have supported this work

assets.description: Optional array of visual assets (diagrams, templates, icons) referenced by practice elements

items.description: Name of another PracticeBaseline (symbolic link; must match another PracticeBaseline.name in the registry).

baselinePracticeNames.description: Optional array of other PracticeBaseline names this baseline depends on (0..* symbolic links; do not embed baseline objects).

practiceElementAliases.description: Optional local aliases for named elements in this baseline (0..*; language.mmd).

Practice.description: A practice names its baseline and may optionally embed baseline-like content; baseline element arrays are not required (language.mmd 0..* on PracticeBaseline edges; Practice only requires baselinePracticeName).

baselinePracticeName.description: Name of the PracticeBaseline this practice depends on (symbolic link; must match PracticeBaseline.name in the method or registry; do not embed the baseline object in this field).

items.description: Name of another Practice (symbolic link; must match Practice.name).

practiceDependencyNames.description: Zero or more other Practice documents by name (symbolic links only; do not embed Practice objects).

practiceElementAliases.description: Optional local aliases for named elements in this practice (0..*; language.mmd).

alphaInstances.description: Optional list of AlphaInstance names used to allow practices to identify instances of concepts or areas of concern within the practice.

workProductInstances.description: Optional list of WorkProductInstance names used to allow practices to identify instances of work products within the practice.

activities.description: Optional flat list of activities (legacy interchange). Canonical shape nests the same Activity objects under ActivitySpace.activities; loaders may fold this array into parents.

workProducts.description: Work products elaborated by this practice (language.mmd).

personaGroups.description: Grouped persona refs (symbolic lists of Persona.name; language.mmd).

narrativeTypes.description: Optional baseline overlay: narrative spine types (unioned like focuses/alphas when merging).

citations.description: Bibliographic references elaborated by this practice.

acknowledgements.description: Acknowledgements of people or institutions that have supported this work

assets.description: Optional array of visual assets (diagrams, templates, icons) referenced by practice elements

PracticeInMethod.description: A practice embedded within a Method's practices array. The 'kind' property is optional since context (being in the practices array) implies it's a practice.

baselinePracticeName.description: Name of the PracticeBaseline this practice depends on (symbolic link; must match PracticeBaseline.name in the method or registry; do not embed the baseline object in this field).

items.description: Name of another Practice (symbolic link; must match Practice.name).

practiceDependencyNames.description: Zero or more other Practice documents by name (symbolic links only; do not embed Practice objects).

practiceElementAliases.description: Optional local aliases for named elements in this practice (0..*; language.mmd).

alphaInstances.description: Optional list of AlphaInstance names used to allow practices to identify instances of concepts or areas of concern within the practice.

workProductInstances.description: Optional list of WorkProductInstance names used to allow practices to identify instances of work products within the practice.

activities.description: Optional flat list of activities (legacy interchange). Canonical shape nests the same Activity objects under ActivitySpace.activities; loaders may fold this array into parents.

workProducts.description: Work products elaborated by this practice (language.mmd).

personaGroups.description: Grouped persona refs (symbolic lists of Persona.name; language.mmd).

narrativeTypes.description: Optional baseline overlay: narrative spine types (unioned like focuses/alphas when merging).

citations.description: Bibliographic references elaborated by this practice.

acknowledgements.description: Acknowledgements of people or institutions that have supported this work

assets.description: Optional array of visual assets (diagrams, templates, icons) referenced by practice elements

baselinePractice.description: Full baseline practice object. Use this OR baselinePracticeName (not both).

baselinePracticeName.description: Symbolic link to baseline practice by name. Use this OR baselinePractice (not both).

practices.description: Array of full Practice objects. Use this OR practiceNames. Practice objects in this array don't require 'kind' property since context implies they are practices.

practiceNames.description: Array of symbolic practice name references. Use this OR practices.

citations.description: Bibliographic references defined in this method (merged from baseline and practices).

acknowledgements.description: Acknowledgements of people or institutions that have supported this work

assets.description: Optional array of visual assets for the entire method (shared across practices)

ResourceLink.description: A named URI reference to an external resource. Used wherever an array of described links is needed (e.g., meeting transcripts, design documents, external dashboards).

name.description: Short descriptive label for the linked resource (e.g., 'Sprint Review Transcript', 'Architecture Decision Record').

Note.description: Timestamped commentary for project tracking. Notes are intended to be brief summaries; use the links array to reference longer documents such as meeting transcripts or detailed reports. Appears at multiple levels within a Project (top-level, plan, current, target, team, checklist states).

name.description: Short summary or title of the note.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp string recording when the note was created.

content.description: The note text. Keep brief — use links for detailed supporting material.

links.description: Optional array of external resource references providing supporting detail (e.g., meeting transcripts, design documents, external reports).

ReferenceUpdate.description: A single cascading reference update within a rename operation. Identifies a specific field on a specific element that must change from one value to another when the renamed element's name changes.

elementType.description: The type of element containing the reference to update (e.g., 'Activity', 'WorkProduct', 'PatternView'). Uses JSON storage names matching PracticeElementAlias.practiceElementType convention.

elementName.description: The name of the element containing the reference field (must match the element's name property).

field.description: The JSON property containing the reference to update (e.g., 'alphaName', 'activitySpaceName', 'focusName', 'contributesTo').

fromValue.description: The current value that must be found in the field (the old name being renamed from).

toValue.description: The replacement value (the new name being renamed to).

AddOperation.description: Add a new practice element to the target document. The element field contains the full element definition. Validation of the element's internal structure against its element type is a tooling concern.

elementType.description: The type of element being added (e.g., 'Alpha', 'WorkProduct', 'Activity', 'Persona', 'Pattern'). Uses JSON storage names matching PracticeElementAlias.practiceElementType convention.

elementName.description: The name of the new element (must match element.name if the element has a name property).

element.description: The full element definition to add. Structure depends on elementType — validation against the specific element type schema is a tooling concern.

rationale.description: Optional explanation of why this element is being added.

ModifyOperation.description: Modify properties of an existing practice element. The modifications field contains a partial overlay with override semantics — unlike the merge algorithm, descriptions CAN be changed. Only the fields present in the modifications object are affected; all other fields are preserved.

elementType.description: The type of element being modified. Uses JSON storage names matching PracticeElementAlias.practiceElementType convention.

elementName.description: The name of the existing element to modify (must match an element in the target document).

modifications.description: Partial overlay containing only the fields to change. Override semantics: provided scalar fields replace existing values. Array fields use the same union-by-name strategy as the merge algorithm. This explicitly differs from standard merge — descriptions CAN be changed here.

rationale.description: Optional explanation of why this modification is being proposed.

RemoveOperation.description: Remove an existing practice element from the target document. Tooling should validate that removal does not leave dangling references.

elementType.description: The type of element being removed. Uses JSON storage names matching PracticeElementAlias.practiceElementType convention.

elementName.description: The name of the existing element to remove (must match an element in the target document).

rationale.description: Optional explanation of why this element is being removed.

RenameOperation.description: Rename an existing practice element. This is a disruptive operation that changes the identity key of an element. The referenceUpdates array MUST include all cascading reference changes within the target document's scope. Prefer adding a PracticeElementAlias (via an add operation) when the original name can be preserved. Use rename only when the canonical name itself must change.

elementType.description: The type of element being renamed. Uses JSON storage names matching PracticeElementAlias.practiceElementType convention.

elementName.description: The current name of the element to rename.

newName.description: The new name for the element.

referenceUpdates.description: All cascading reference updates required within the target document's scope. This array MUST be exhaustive — every structural reference to the old name must be listed. Tooling should validate completeness.

rationale.description: Optional explanation of why the rename is necessary (rather than using an alias).

ChangeOperation.description: A single proposed change to a practice element. Discriminated by the 'operation' const field. To add an alias, use an AddOperation with elementType 'PracticeElementAlias' and a PracticeElementAlias as the element.

DownstreamImpact.description: Advisory metadata identifying a downstream document affected by this change request and what changes it would need. Helps dependent practice/method authors understand what refactoring is needed when the upstream change is accepted.

documentName.description: The name of the downstream document affected (matches the document's root name property).

documentType.description: The root type of the downstream document.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of how this change affects the downstream document and what adaptation is needed.

suggestedOperations.description: Optional array of suggested ChangeOperations that the downstream document would need to apply. These are advisory — the downstream author may choose different adaptations.

ChangeRequest.description: A proposed set of changes to a Practice Language document (practice, baseline, or method). Functions as a pull-request-like mechanism — operations are grouped atomically, can be reviewed, and can be temporarily applied in merges for preview. ChangeRequest is a meta-document about changes, not a methodology element; its identity is changeId, not name.

changeId.description: Human-readable pseudo-UUID identifying this change request. Convention: author-slug + date + time in format 'author-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS' (e.g., 'eseymour-20260729-143022'). Must be unique within the scope of the target document's lifecycle.

targetDocumentName.description: The name of the document this change request targets (must match the target document's root name property).

targetDocumentType.description: The root type of the target document. Projects are excluded — change requests target methodology definitions, not execution instances.

status.description: Lifecycle status. draft: being authored. proposed: submitted for review. accepted: approved for application. rejected: declined. withdrawn: retracted by author.

note.description: A Note describing the change request — what it proposes, why, and relevant context. Use the note's links array to reference supporting materials.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when this change request was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent modification.

operations.description: Ordered array of change operations. Applied in sequence — order matters. Must contain at least one operation.

downstreamImpacts.description: Optional advisory metadata identifying downstream documents affected by this change and what adaptations they would need.

reviewNotes.description: Optional timestamped notes from the review process (reviewer comments, discussion outcomes, revision history).

supersedes.description: Optional changeId of a previous ChangeRequest that this one replaces. Creates a revision chain for traceability.

ChangeSet.description: A batch of ChangeRequests reviewed and applied together. Groups related changes that span one or more target documents into a single reviewable unit. Discriminated at root level by the presence of changeSetId.

changeSetId.description: Human-readable pseudo-UUID identifying this change set. Same convention as changeId: author-slug + date + time (e.g., 'eseymour-20260729-150000').

status.description: Lifecycle status of the entire set. When accepted, all contained ChangeRequests are accepted together; when rejected, all are rejected.

note.description: A Note describing the overall change set — the cohesive rationale for grouping these changes together.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when this change set was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent modification.

changeRequests.description: Ordered array of ChangeRequests in this batch. Applied in sequence. May target different documents.

reviewNotes.description: Optional timestamped notes from the review process covering the set as a whole.

ChecklistState.description: Tracks the completion status of an individual checklist item within a project context. Co-located on AlphaInstance or WorkProductInstance; the parent instance provides the alpha/state or workProduct/levelOfDetail context.

checklistName.description: Name of the specific Checklist item (must match a Checklist.name within the parent instance's referenced State or LevelOfDetail).

state.description: Completion status. In current section: records actual completion. In target section: indicates whether the checklist item is required for this project's goals.

evidenceUri.description: Optional URI linking to external evidence supporting the checklist item's state (e.g. a document, test result, approval record, or audit artifact).

notes.description: Optional notes recording observations or rationale for the checklist item's state.

CommunicationChannel.description: A team's preferred interaction point — the place other people should go to find or reach the team.

name.description: Human-readable label for the channel (e.g. 'Slack', 'Team Email', 'Weekly Sync', 'Backlog').

address.description: The channel's address or location (e.g. '#platform-eng', 'platform@example.com', 'Tuesdays 10:00 UTC').

TeamMember.description: Identifies a person on the project team, their role within the methodology, and how to contact them.

personaName.description: Symbolic link to a Persona defined in the resolved practice/method scope, identifying their role.

contact.description: A contact address (e.g. email, chat handle, phone). Format is not constrained.

started.description: Optional ISO timestamp recording when this member joined the project.

finished.description: Optional ISO timestamp recording when this member left the project.

TeamEntry.description: Describes the project team. Inspired by the Team API concept from Team Topologies, making the team's purpose, membership, and communication preferences discoverable.

description.description: Brief statement of the team's focus and purpose within this project.

communicationChannels.description: Optional array of communication channels describing how to interact with this team.

members.description: Array of team members with their roles and contact details.

notes.description: Optional notes for team-level observations, decisions, and changes over time.

ProjectPlan.description: The plan section of a Project. Contains an embedded Pattern defining the project's lifecycle plan, and a notes array for plan-level commentary.

pattern.description: Embedded Pattern object defining the project's lifecycle plan. This is a new instance owned by the project, not a symbolic link. The Pattern's alphaInstanceNames and workProductInstanceNames declare tracked instances; its PatternViews define phased objectives.

notes.description: Optional notes for plan-level commentary, decisions, and rationale about the planning process itself.

ProjectStateSection.description: Shared structure for the current and target sections of a Project. Contains arrays of AlphaInstance and WorkProductInstance objects (which carry their own ChecklistState arrays) plus notes.

alphaInstances.description: Alpha instances recording state (current assessment or target goal). Each instance may carry checklistStates for granular tracking.

workProductInstances.description: Work product instances recording level of detail (current assessment or target goal). Each instance may carry checklistStates for granular tracking.

notes.description: Optional notes providing timestamped observations and commentary.

Project.description: An execution instance of a Practice or Method, tracking real-world progress against a plan. Contains team, plan, current state, and target state sections.

practiceName.description: Symbolic link to a Practice by name. Exactly one of practiceName or methodName must be present.

methodName.description: Symbolic link to a Method by name. Exactly one of practiceName or methodName must be present.

team.description: The project team — who is involved, what they do, and how to reach them.

plan.description: The project plan containing an embedded Pattern and plan-level notes.

current.description: Currently assessed state of tracked alphas and work products.

target.description: Desired/goal state for tracked alphas and work products.

notes.description: Project-wide notes for observations, decisions, and commentary not specific to plan, current, target, or team.

citations.description: Bibliographic references relevant to this project.

acknowledgements.description: Acknowledgements of people or institutions that have supported this project.

assets.description: Optional array of visual assets for this project.
